title: VASS is a 1,509-person Spanish-capital digital-native integrator awaiting an OSS screen
content:
VASS is a Spanish-capital integrator of 1,509 staff as of 2024, described as digital-native. Domestic ownership and that positioning are the two resolved facts, and both are the kind that usually score in favour: technology direction set in-market, and no legacy delivery model to unwind.

Nothing technical was researched — no stack, no open-source posture — so the lead is placed on ownership and positioning alone. At 1,509 people it also sits on the large side of the range this set treats as workable for an early partner. Priority 4, needs OSS screen.
